chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far, who said:
I heard al-Rida عليه السلام saying: Indeed, Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, and his wife and his sons, are among the people of Paradise.
Then he عليه السلام said: Whoever recognizes this matter from the children of Ali and Fatimah عليها السلام is not like the people.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fatimah عليها السلام, mother of the purified progeny
key_terms.لَمْ يَكُنْ كَالنَّاسِ: he is not like ordinary people; indicating distinction in rank or state
key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرَ: this matter, referring in context to the recognized divine affair of wilayah
key_terms.وُلْدِ عَلِيٍّ: the descendants of Ali عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about those from the children of Ali and Fatimah عليهم السلام who recognize the matter of wilayah?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the virtue of a specific descendant of the Ahl al-Bayt and his household by describing them as among the people of Paradise. It also states that those from the progeny of Ali and Fatimah عليهم السلام who recognize this matter, meaning the true affair of wilayah and authority, are distinct from ordinary people.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far who said,

‘I heard Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Ali Bin Abdullah son of Al-Husayn Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>, and his wife and his sons are from the inhabitants of the Paradise’.

Then he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘The ones who recognise this matter (Al-Wilayah), from the children of Ali<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> and Fatima<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, do not happen to be like the (ordinary) people’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sulayman ibn Ja‘far who has said the following.
“I heards al-Rida (a.s.) saying, “Ali ibn ‘Abdallah (or ‘Ubaydallah)ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.), his wife and childred are of the people of paradise.”
He then said, “Whoever would recognize this matter (Leadership with Divine Authority) in the descendants of Ali and Fatima (a.s.) he would not be like the people.”
